name: sentinel
description: Marks every file Claude writes with a manual-review sentinel line, guards it from removal, and blocks commits until a person deletes it.

commitWrapper.title: Commit wrapper pattern
commitWrapper.description: Regular expression matched against each line of a Bash command. A matching line is gated like `git commit`, in the repository named by its `-C <dir>`, else a leading `cd`, else the session's directory. Use it for scripts that run `git commit` internally. Empty: only `git commit` is gated.

fileTypes.title: File types
fileTypes.description: JSON object of changes to the built-in sentinel file types: ".ext" or a file name mapped to a style entry, or false to turn it off. Edit with /sentinel-types.
